programme.title: Mr.Player
programme.desc: Jacky Wu leads a team of celebrity guests through energetic missions staged in different destinations. The players compete in creative games, physical challenges and surprise tasks that test teamwork, strategy and humour.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings.

programme.title: (侦探迪伊和九层恶魔建筑) Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: ((唐探1900)) Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: (1900年代,在旧金山,中国城一名白人妇女被谋杀,中国男子成为主要嫌疑犯。 犯罪引发公众的强烈抗议,以关闭该区。 在不断加剧的动乱中,两名中国侦探秦富和阿贵与时间竞争,在偏见和危险吞噬他们的社区之前发现真正的凶手。) In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: ((扫毒2：天地对决)) The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: ((看不见的客人)) The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: (年轻和美丽的企业家Joanna是一起密室谋杀的主要嫌疑犯,她的情人在那里被发现死亡。她付钱请一名警官证明她无罪。在调查期间,他们发现了另一起涉及Joanna和她的情人的谋杀案,最终揭露了真相。) Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: ((爱的风暴)) L Storm
programme.desc: (ICAC总长卢克和刘总督察刘总督察在调查他们各自的贿赂和洗钱案件时都一败涂地。 当Luk在被洗钱者陷害后被指控受贿时,他冒着一切风险去找到不利于他们的关键证据来澄清自己的名字。) ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: ((韩城攻略)) Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: (日本国家安全局的一个特工和一个熟练的小偷一起找到了一张用来伪造美元的牌照。 但是,一位美国大使馆代表却出现并偷走了车牌,带着车牌逃往韩国。) A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: (站起来故事) Stand Up Story
programme.desc: (Mancer知道父亲Wah年轻时在智力上受到挑战,在母亲离开后必须照顾他。 当Mancer发现并找到立体喜剧中的安慰时,他了解到困难提供了最好的喜剧材料 — — 从他在学校的嘲弄经历到大灾难,痛苦会激起欢笑!) Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: ((失衡凶间之恶念之最)) Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: ((烈焰焚城)) Sky on Fire
programme.desc: (最高机密医疗设施的首席保安官发现自己在一场爆炸性战斗中被卷入其中,当时一名年轻的小偷偷走了突破性药品。 但是,在发现了药品的真正来源后,该官员必须决定他能够信任谁来保护治愈方法不被误入坏人之手并防止一场全面战争。) The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: ((爆水管)) Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: (镇上几乎不存在犯罪,警察面对斧头。为了挽救他们的工作,Yu Da Hai警官为他的团队制造了一场假抢劫,以英勇地挫败他们的队伍。他不知道,一帮劫墓者正在向地铁站下面埋藏的宝藏挖隧道。当水管爆炸时,混乱爆发,警察与骗子之间的界线模糊不清。) With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: ((邪Mall)) Possession Street
programme.desc: (当七位复仇的灵灵将废弃商场的租户变成僵尸,一个视频店主、他的女儿和一个风水大师必须为生存而奋斗。 随着不死之星的繁衍和邪恶幽灵的强大,他们争先恐后地阻止整个商场陷入地狱。) When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: (像我这样的人) Someone Like Me
programme.desc: (穆伊与大脑麻痹者生活在一起,渴望联系和遇到志工坚。 随着他们受伤的灵魂越来越近,她开始重新思考爱及其超越身体极限的自我价值,发现以自己的条件拥抱生命和亲密的勇气。) Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: ((孤星计划)) Burning Stars
programme.desc: (20世纪20年代,在白恐怖的阴影下,李仪民特工(Li Yi Min)在上海的阴影下,负责护送一位关键人物安全。 他与前盟友团聚,突破致命的陷阱。 在动乱中,一群理想主义青年加入了这场事业,冒着一切风险捍卫使命并在混乱时期找到勇气。) Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: ((野性新加坡)) Wild City
programme.desc: (当酒吧老板的死党兄弟和装满现金的手提箱进入照片中时,追逐就会变得致命。) A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: ((最后的舞动)) The Last Dance
programme.desc: (在这场大流行病引发的经济衰退中,负债累累的婚礼策划者沈成在他向丧葬计划者过渡的过程中找到了一条生命线。 他的非常规方法导致出乎意料的成功,他对他的职业生涯和生活的态度在受到尊敬的温大师的启发后发生了转变。) Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: ((第二十条)) Article 20
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his sons clash with another student in school and his wifes intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: ((神探大战)) Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: (香港被一系列冷血谋杀事件所震撼,受害者是未解决案件的逃跑嫌疑人.这群杀手自称是选中的杀手.前高级侦探李誓言将残忍的杀手绳之以法,证明自己是真正的选中的杀手,而不是疯子.) Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: ((前任4：英年早婚)) The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: (孟云和优飞这两个兄弟已经到了适婚年龄,在恋爱中面临挑战。 云在分手后逃避家庭结婚的压力,而飞及其女朋友选择婚姻冷却期来解决婚姻问题。) Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a marriage cooling-off period to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: ((酱园弄·翻案)) Shes Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: ((九龙城寨之围城)) Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: (少年陈洛克昆在逃跑时意外偶然偶然撞入了科隆城墙,随后在混乱中找到目的,并获得智慧.与辛,十二师和AV结合在一起,他们团结在一起,以防暴风雨的领导,大先生的攻击,并承诺共同保护城墙的安全港口.) Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the Kowloon Walled City while fleeing, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom. Bonding with Shin, Twelfth Master and AV, they unite under Tornados leadership to defend against the villain, Mr Bigs assaults, and pledge to protect the safe haven of the Walled City together.

programme.title: ((千萬別抬頭)) Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kongs Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: ((雷霆行动)) Ultimate Revenge
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As task force leader Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers. Old scores and new grievances collide as team member Cheung Ka Wo, driven by his brothers death, begins to unravel, and a brutal shootout uncovers a secret buried for years.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: ((英雄无泪)) Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: (高清飞是一个年轻的剑手,他拿着一把特殊的剑,其刀片上刻有泪滴。 他负责避免武术界迫在眉睫的危机,但恶棍周通莱希望成为武术界的统治者,并发起一个计划,使各种英雄相互对立。) Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: ((椰林春恋)) Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: (发自纽约 — — 学生们正在接待来自香港的访客。 学生们在接待来自香港的访客的同时,也爱上了千珍,这引发了紧张。 嫉妒、杨兰暴风雨、学生们在得知订婚后撞车。 误解最终被清除,幸福随之而来。) Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: ((铁罗汉)) The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiaos Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: ((鬼马神偷)) The Big Sting
programme.desc: (三个朋友发现一个罕见的古物,被称为双面神,但被夫人毒害,她偷了宝藏.在他们死之前,他们让他们的妻子承诺训练他们的孩子,) Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: (五号杀手) Killers Five
programme.desc: (杜克斯女儿被臭名昭著的金龙山强盗绑架.一个名叫贝的剑手被派去拯救她,在旅途中预计许多危险,获得了来自一群善良的朋友的帮助,他们也是功夫大师.) The Dukes daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: ((蝴蝶杯)) The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: ((笑傲江湖)) The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clans disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score The Proud One. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clans leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: ((野姑娘)) Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: (是一个的村子女孩,她不怕反击暴徒.她遇到了最大的子的麻烦,当她与女仆打败他的计划时,让策划复仇.) Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: ((奇门怪招烂头蟀)) The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by Drunken Master, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: ((瀛台泣血)) The Last Tempest
programme.desc: (多华王后继此事件之后,广州皇帝和多瓦赫王后仍继续传说光苏和西西皇后的故事。 尽管广州皇帝登上皇宫,但西西始终存在的势力掩盖了他有效统治的能力。 当他改革帝国体制的尝试被多瓦高太后挫败时,广州试图扼制她的权力。) This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: (许多香水的土地) The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: (僧桑,子,猪和沙武发现自己在女人之地,) Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: ((Melody of Love（美国1928年Arch Heath执导的爱情剧情电影）)) Melody of Love
programme.desc: (三位年轻的医生在70年代的浪漫电影中追求三个难以获得的美貌。 他们不知道从哪开始,用石头剪刀方法与女孩比对。 他们使用的策略和技巧非常滑稽,在毫无成功可言的情况下,他们必须调整计划!) Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: (勇敢的弓箭手) The Brave Archer
programme.desc: (在回到中部地区的路上,郭遇到了黄龙,他们很快就恋爱了.然而,乌阳凯同时提出嫁给黄龙,所以黄龙的父亲为两人争夺她的手设定了一场决斗.郭最终击败了乌阳凯,以赢得黄龙.) On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huangs father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: ((山歌恋)) The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: (在这部音乐剧中,一个漂亮的牧羊女,Hsiu Hsiu,爱上了一个漂亮的船员Ta Lung.然而,她不能嫁给他,因为她的父亲从博上借债.) In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: ((中国超人)) Super Inframan
programme.desc: (由一位年轻的实验室研究员改造而来 以雷电战为主的印度佛教徒 必须与从冬眠中醒来的 龙妈妈公主战斗) Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: ((鬼新娘)) The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: (方明娶了神秘的年轻女士梁秋平,只为了发现她是一个被迫消耗男人生命精华的精神。 在道教的帮助下,他将她从邪恶的力量中解救出来,但他们的爱无法跨越生死,他们黎明时分就以苦痛的告别告别。) Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: ((冰雪情关英雄胆)) The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: (在唐王朝中,沙土王的13个养子都是以皇家勇士闻名的。 大卫·蒋扮演十三王子,他是一个强大的斗士,他的地位令人嫉妒,导致可怕的家庭争斗。) Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: ((无名英雄)) The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gangs girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the Anonymous Heroes of the revolution.

programme.title: ((萧十一郎)) Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: (西·易兰格是所有人都想杀的剑手. 一个壮丽的剑甚至是为了这个目的创造的,尽管刀剑很快被追捧的比剑手死亡!) Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsmans death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: ((保护者)) The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the masters granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: ((没有老公的日子)) Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: (当一位医生的丈夫东先生在一次事故中受致命伤时,他向她透露了他与小黑的婚外情,他与小黑怀孕了。 尽管背叛的破坏和丈夫最终死亡,但她婆婆还是施加压力,要她忍受小黑,为她的孩子提供1M。) When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: ((群英会)) Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: (一部由三部故事组成的功夫传说电影:一个男人在试图向他爱的女人的父亲证明自己值得的男人.一个爱上将军的妓女,需要交付一个臭名昭著的强盗,以换取他不会被处决.) A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: ((夺魂铃)) The Bells of Death
programme.desc: (魏富是一个无足轻重的木匠。 然而,当疯子劫掠者杀害家人并绑架其姐姐时,他与一位武士专家一起接受严酷的武术训练,以报复不法者。) Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: ((剑神不败)) The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagles own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: ((奸人鬼)) A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: (一个父母分居的年轻男孩试图在生活中找到幸福。 有一天,他遇见和交朋友的是一个善良的仁爱心,他决定让父母团聚,让他真正幸福。) A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Valimai
programme.desc: A citys crime rate rises due to a notorious motorcycle club. When chaos ensues, police officer Arjun takes charge to restore law and order.

programme.title: Enai Noki Paayum Thota
programme.desc: Lovers Raghu and Lekha are torn apart by Lekhas guardian, Kuberan, who forces her to act in films. Years later, Raghu receives a call from her informing him about his estranged brother.

programme.title: Irumbu Thirai
programme.desc: A military officer borrows money for his sisters marriage using fake papers. When the money goes missing from his account, he embarks on an investigation that uncovers a hacker.

programme.title: Nayakan
programme.desc: A regular person fights unfair police, becoming a criminal boss. People like and respect him, but his power comes at a high price. It changes him and those around him.

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.

programme.title: Thondan
programme.desc: Narayanan, a politicians son, assaults Vishnu when his brother dies in his ambulance. Later, he makes Vishnus life miserable by bribing the local police officers and government officials.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: Set in an abandoned house, the film follows a team of professional ghost hunters trying to conduct a paranormal investigation to unveil the mystery of two sisters.

programme.title: Kolamaavu Kokila
programme.desc: A young girl in Tamil Nadu turns to the local drug gang to save her dying mother, risking danger, loyalty, and her own future dramatically today.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Thunder
programme.desc: A CBI officer gains consciousness after being in coma and finds everyone referring to him as Godse. He discovers that it is a trap set up by a CM.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: A young man struggles to find his place after moving in with his sister and her in-laws.

programme.title: Mersal
programme.desc: Maaran, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.

programme.title: Kadaisi Nodigal
programme.desc: When a serial killer goes on a murder spree, Samuel, a forensic expert, uses his skills to find evidence and uncover the killers identity.

programme.title: Sirai
programme.desc: Police officer Kathiravan must escort a prisoner from Vellore to Sivagangai court. Along the long road, unexpected encounters force both men to question everything they know.

programme.desc: (从费城的肯内尔俱乐部,所有爱狗者的宝贵竞赛在17年才到来。由约翰·奥胡利主办,这次活动有2 000个领先的犬类国家,包括世界最大、最小和最奇特的犬类。170多个品种的繁殖希望成为这一年的顶级狗。 戴维·弗雷院长提供了专家表演评论,玛丽·卡里略·希姆斯作为这次最终的犬类决赛的副报导员也加入了其中。但是,哪只狗的一天是他们的一天,而后尾的两条则在它们两条腿之间。 毕竟,在表演中只能有一个最好的。) From the Kennel Club of Philadelphia, this cherished competition for all dog lovers returns for the 17th year. The Dean David Frei provides expert show commentary, and Mary Carillo chimes in as an adept sideline reporter for this ultimate canine showdown. programme.desc: (约安娜去伊朗,探索了大居魯士的坟墓,然后沿着亚塞拜疆,格鲁吉亚的丝之路前往威尼斯.) Joanna visits Iran, exploring the tomb of Cyrus the Great before following the Silk Road through Azerbaijan, Georgia and on to Venice. Then shes off to Haiti and Cuba for some more unseen adventures.

programme.desc: Chef Edward Lee and Ryu Sooyoung explore Koreas summer seafood traditions, starting in Gwangju where they fight the heat with hot croaker soup.

programme.title: ((Ben Fogle - 百度百科)) Where the Wild Men Are with Ben Fogle
programme.desc: (Ben Fagle前往特纳里费岛拜访年轻夫妇Emma和Edo, 他们拯救几匹马的野心创造了一个社区农场和完全不同的野外避难所。) Ben Fogle heads to the island of Tenerife to visit young couple Emma and Edo, whose ambition to rescue a few horses has created a community farm and very different wild sanctuary.

programme.title: ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球)) Wild Side of the Moon
programme.desc: (由月球力量引导的史诗之旅。看看看不见的信号如何引导海洋迁徙路线沿线的鲸鱼和海龟,带夜仓鸟横跨各大洲,并观察月光航行的鸽子和其他昆虫。) Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: (吉姆伯利:澳大利亚西部) The Kimberley: Australias Wild West
programme.desc: (避免鱼的皮和羽毛的危险,看 koolamana 鱼争取伴侣,和鱼的幼儿一起吃饭.) Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: ((阿尔法战士)) Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: (非洲沙文娜是一个史诗般的景观,无论是头的鱼,激素狂热的大象,还是斗争的狮子,) The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether its head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

programme.title: ((Kenya Wild终生惩戒 Diaries)) Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. Theyve also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants needs - and to see if theyre returning to their natural corridors.

programme.title: ((未发掘之景观)) Undiscovered Vistas
programme.desc: (了解世界上最大的火山岛,一个孤独和崎岖的地方,蒸汽泄漏、水爆炸和新地每天都在诞生。 看看火和冰如何在一场战斗中相撞,这场战斗使这个岛屿成为地球上地质最强大的岛屿。) Learn about the worlds largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

programme.title: ((未发掘之景观)) Undiscovered Vistas
programme.desc: (这座由火山建造、但由冰块雕刻的岛屿旅游。 大约150万年前,一片冰块从北部降下,覆盖了这片土地。 如今,巨大的冰川继续砍伐海洋悬崖,砍伐山岳。 冰层不断形成。) Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

programme.title: ((未发掘之景观)) Undiscovered Vistas
programme.desc: (踏入Fundys湾的涌现水域。了解东海岸生态系统是如何维持大量生物的,包括数十万只海鸟、世界最快的捕食者以及复杂的无脊椎动物网络。) Step into the Bay of Fundys surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the worlds fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: ((未发掘之景观)) Undiscovered Vistas
programme.desc: (沿着英国的西海岸旅行,在那里,世界最长的无间断足迹在800多英里的令人叹为观止的景象中形成。 这个巨型海岸充满了野生动物、地质奥秘和数百年人类历史。) Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the worlds longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

programme.title: ((未发掘之景观)) Undiscovered Vistas
programme.desc: (探索一个被强大的大西洋环绕的岛屿,遭受着冲击波和暴雨的冲击。 从摩尔断崖到巨人高速公路,这片土地被水力和暴力的地质力量所塑造和改造。) Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giants Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

programme.title: ((未发掘之景观)) Undiscovered Vistas
programme.desc: (不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华岛西海岸的荒野太平洋海岸。从山峰冰川到加拿大的树冠只有雨林、自然和人类精神在壮观的生境中共存。) Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canadas only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

programme.title: ((生命之树)) Rooted
programme.desc: (横跨波纹沙丘,在卡拉哈里南部风湿的草原上,一座雄伟的骆驼角,它在这里站了两个世纪。这棵树从来不孤单,知道它如何为许多生物提供食物、住所和狩猎场。) Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: ((生命之树)) Rooted
programme.desc: (发现深受爱戴的香肠树的故事,它花蜜盛开,香肠制成的水果吸引各种动物,从昆虫到大象。 看看依赖这棵慷慨的树的动物如何确保它的扩散。) Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: ((生命之树)) Rooted
programme.desc: (在一片迷雾的南非森林里,长了6百年的奥特尼夸黄木。在40米高的地方,她高在树冠上,是她这一类人中仅有的少数。 顺从她那迷人的故事,她的树枝是独特的生态系统。) In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: ((生命之树)) Rooted
programme.desc: (在南非纳马夸兰的一个岩石山坡上扎根的Namaqua Rock Fig树站着。 它是终极生存者,能够在每年面临气温不断上升和降雨量越来越少的风景中忍受无情的环境条件。) The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programme.title: ((生命之树)) Rooted
programme.desc: (这是一棵树的令人难以置信的故事,它已经存在了八百年,能够忍受最恶劣的条件,并且比任何其他人更受昆虫、鸟类和动物的爱戴。) This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years that can withstand the harshest conditions and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any otherthe enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: ((鲨王争霸战)) Boss Shark
programme.desc: (随着科学家们试图在新西兰海岸的100多个大白群中挑选一个阿尔法雄性,他们会见证主导地位的最终战斗.) Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）)) Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: (在南澳大利亚州执行一个危险的拖拖任务,该任务将展示鲨鱼吃什么,为什么它们聚集在热点地区。 然后,当一个团队向北追赶老虎、公牛和锤头鲨鱼,并装配一个带有360度双角相机的鲨鱼。) Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）)) Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: (跟踪大堡礁沿岸的一头怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她是否带领一组科学家到她隐藏的抽水场。 然后在南部海岸寻找交配的迹象,这些迹象可能暴露出一个非常害羞的雌性巨型巨型巨型猎物,以寻找伴侣。) Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）)) Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: (等到北方小组把活动标记 挂在公牛鲨鱼身上 并找出这个夜猫子在日落后做什么) Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）)) Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: (北方团队研究年轻黑人如何学习社交和生存技能。 然后和南方团队一起匆忙前往彩虹海滩,他们渴望看到沙虎鲨鱼最难以捉摸的行为:交配。) Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）)) Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: (前往澳洲鲨鱼高速公路的终点。 查查南方的格林利岛是否是 迁徙大白鲨的卡车站,) Travel to the ends of Australias shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）)) Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: (南方团队在测试新的移民技术和工具以降低在流行的浮游点对鲨鱼的袭击。 然后与北方团队一起捕捉和标记公牛鲨鱼,后者想帮助当地游泳者远离生母。) Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.desc: (随着科学家们试图在新西兰海岸的100多个大白群中挑选一个阿尔法雄性,他们会见证主导地位的最终战斗.) programme.title: ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）)) Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: (南方团队在测试新的移民技术和工具以降低在流行的浮游点对鲨鱼的袭击。 然后与北方团队一起捕捉和标记公牛鲨鱼,后者想帮助当地游泳者远离生母。) Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: ((阿尔法战士)) Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: (欢迎来到印度——一个有异国动物和异国战争的地方。 猴子舞台灰尘般的灰尘堆积,黑桶在开阔的平原上发动公开战争,孔雀舞花摇摆开刀片:这些是值得充满活力的土地的多彩战斗。) Welcome to India - a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

programme.title: ((Kenya Wild终生惩戒 Diaries)) Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: (在肯尼亚,大象狩猎已经被禁止40年了。 有组织的武装偷猎者团伙仍然以大象为目标,非法猎捕大象,并在黑市上出售象牙象牙。 环保主义者和环保主义者正在发出警报。) Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.

programme.title: ((塞尔达传说：王国之泪 - 百度百科)) Kingdom Of The Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: (野生的岩石) Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Where the mountains cross international borders, herds of elk and moose live side by side with predators like bears and wolves. The predatorprey relationship is a delicate balance, and the perfect place to see it in action is the Kootenay area of the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: (野生的岩石) Wild Rockies
programme.desc: The air is thin and cold, trees cant even live here -- its not exactly a welcoming place to live. But animals like mountain goats and bighorn sheep and even black bears manage to skitter around these peaks with ease. Well take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.

programme.title: (野生的岩石) Wild Rockies
programme.desc: (北美一些最强大的河流来自落基山脉的冰川高地。落基山脉的湖泊、河流和沼泽就像在地表上翻滚的动脉,喂养着称为山丘家园的生物。被冰川吞噬并并受重力驱动,这些水道被大块的落基山脉分割开来,这些河流将流向大西洋、太平洋和北极海洋。从无法居住的冰层中流出,冰川上的水融化,从雷鸣般的瀑布下流,通过湿地的过滤,雕塑地形,最后流向海洋,维持生命,并沿途改变环境。) Some of mightiest rivers in North America originate on the glacial heights of the Rocky Mountains. The lakes, rivers and marshes of the Rockies are like arteries pulsing through the landscape, feeding the creatures that call the mountains home. Fed by glaciers and motivated by gravity, these waterways are split by the massive Rockies, which divert flow into the Atlantic, Pacific, and Arctic Oceans. From the uninhabitable icy pecks, water melts off glaciers, runs down thunderous waterfalls, filters through wetlands, sculpts the terrain, and finally flows out to the ocean, sustaining life and transforming environments along the way.

programme.title: (野生的岩石) Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs cant grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

programme.title: (野生的岩石) Wild Rockies
programme.desc: For a great many species, the structures of group living are the most important for survival. Although social living is integral to many of the animals that call the Rocky Mountains home, no two species organize their society in the same way. Even among closely related species there can be drastic differences in social structure communication, hierarchy, mating, and diet are all inextricably informed by specific environmental and genetic adaptations for group survival.

programme.title: ((赞比亚传奇)) Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: (桑比亚斯·卢昂瓦谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正使它特别的是它的鸟类。这里有400多个不同的物种,每个物种都完全适合利用每一个机会。) Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: ((赞比亚传奇)) Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: (非洲是一个充满独特和非凡的动物的大陆,其生命是由数百万年的进化过程塑造的。非洲也是人类的诞生地。我们在自己的进化历程上与各大陆的动物一起旅行,然而智慧使我们走上了一条完全不同的道路。我们的好奇心引出了关于我们周围世界的问题,这些问题通过故事、神话和传说得到了解答。) Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: ((赞比亚传奇)) Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: (智利是一只大象,半个树干将小便输给偷猎者,目的是捕捉蚂蚁作为灌木。但是,滥杀滥伤自然意味着其他动物经常与它们发生染污,并产生毁灭性后果。智利现在必须适应没有最重要的大象附着物的生活。她必须学会如何吃饭、喝酒和洗泥浴,以确保她的生存。由于严酷的旱季的附加挑战,智利正在对抗生存的机率。) Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: ((赞比亚传奇)) Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: (非洲最古老的树木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵树都有自己在旱季生存的战略。 香肠树和无花果树的季节性极端,为在贫瘠时期挣扎的动物提供食物和栖身之处。 作为回报,动物通过授粉花朵和分散种子来帮助这些树木繁殖。 非洲树木促进生命,并成为地球上最宝贵的生态系统之一的支柱。) Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: (大洋最伟大的节日) The Oceans Greatest Feast
programme.desc: (在最大的生物量迁徙的行星上获得前排座位,每年1000英里的沙丁鱼沿着南非东海岸运行。 这些小鱼中有数十亿只是饥饿的掠食动物,包括偷猎海豹和潜水炸弹。) Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.desc: Venture along Earths coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

programme.title: Olivia

programme.title: Caspers Scare School
programme.desc: A Haunting Smell - Caspers Uncle Stinky has started to stink just that extra bit TOO much. Fatso and Stretch just cannot stand Stinkys horrible smell for one single minute longer and they hatch a plan. They decide to wait for Stinky to fall asleep and then vacuum up the dreaded stink right out of Stinky. It works! the bad smell goes into the hoover bag but as the uncles start arguing, the bag bursts open and the bad smell escapes! The smell collides with Casper while hes going through the Dimension Tube to get back to Scare School and now its CASPER whos the stinky one. When Casper starts to stink out the school, everyones complaining.. Casper must do everything possible to get rid of the STINK! The Manor has Disappeared - Caspers uncles are out of town and have left the little ghost to take care of the Manor - Casper invites his best friend Jimmy over for a tour of the haunted manor - Casper even shows Jimmy the clock that controls the Dimension Tube connecting the manor to Scare School. Jimmy cant resist fiddling with EVERYTHING! - and as Jimmy pulls the wrong chain three times in a row he and the manor are sucked into the tube and shrunken down to the size of a hand! Casper has a massive problem on his hands as the little tiny house with the little tiny munchkin inside it causes a huge stir at Scare School and its all Caspers fault! Hes got only hours before his Uncles return to rescue his friend from perpetual munchkin-sizedness AND return his Uncles manor as they left it!

programme.title: Caspers Scare School
programme.desc: Thatch My Idol - Casper has really had enough of seeing Thatch bully his friends so he sprays him with a perfume he found in his uncles magic ointment box. This perfume is supposed to turn the one who wears it into the loveliest person in the worldbut actually it just makes OTHERS think youre great, whilst not actually changing the person its been sprayed on! Thatch becomes more unbearable than ever as the kids at Scare School start to treat him like the biggest hero ever, totally putting him on a pedestal of sickening adoration.. Luckily, Caspers nose is blocked by a cold so he is the only student immune to the perfumes spell! He is also the only one who can fix his mistake! The Monster Catcher - Casper has been given a mysterious compass which belonged to his ancestor Jasper the Jester. The compass leads him to a secret room in Scare School. He takes his friends to this room and the three little monsters soon realize they are actually trapped in a terrible labyrinth! The situation gets worse when some crazy traps suddenly separate the three friends. They must find a way out but they will have to solve Caspers ancestors bizarre set of puzzles first!

programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生

programme.title: 少年叶问之危机时刻
programme.desc: 1917年，少年叶问初到香港求学英文演讲比赛当天，学校发生一宗惊天绑架案，全校同学都被挟持面对眼前的危机，叶问挺身而出，发现绑匪竟然是自己的师父和好兄弟少年叶问在危机时刻可否打败绑匪，从而伸张正义？

programme.title: 靓足100分
programme.desc: 林天赐的富商祖父病重，欲将遗产留给他，但条件是天赐要在一个月内结婚，否则遗产将归祖父侄儿罗伯特不久天赐邂逅乐小小，两人渐生情愫罗伯特即派玛丽琳利用美人计破坏他俩的感情不料玛丽琳贪图遗产，准备真的与林结婚罗心有不甘，捣乱婚礼，并揭发她的计谋

programme.title: 龙门飞甲
programme.desc: 本片重拍自1966年经典武侠片龙门客栈，当时东厂与西厂宦官掌控朝政，腐败横行侠客赵怀安与一群刺客联手，秘密铲除宦官势力，维护忠良与国家安定

programme.title: 灵幻先生
programme.desc: 江湖术士茅山明无法驱除复仇的怨灵，只得与他的鬼同伴一起逃脱他们躲进一个村庄后，遇到了意图灭绝人类的邪恶女魔头于是，茅山明与师父九叔携手合作，对抗这位威胁村民的魔头他们能否战胜黑暗势力，赢得最终的胜利？

programme.title: 混世四猴：神猴归来
programme.desc: 救世主灵明石猴曾赐予绝望女孩生存的希望，并许下守护终生的承诺不料多年后，他与傲慢的三眼战神展开一场毁天灭地的大战，最终惨遭击败，金身碎裂堕入凡尘失去神力的石猴，究竟能否重燃斗志，打破命运枷锁，再度归来履行当年对女孩许下的誓言？

programme.title: 青蛙王子
programme.desc: 此喜剧在夏威夷开始，富家子为人腼腆，追女乏术，好友充当其爱情顾问，带他四出泡妞，却碰得一鼻子灰，闹出连场笑话

programme.title: 降龙大师：魔龙咒
programme.desc: 龙王被降龙大师封印了五百年，龙王之女为解除父亲的封印，不惜穿越时空，回到五百年前杀掉降龙大师但她没想到五百年前的龙王与降龙大师竟是生死挚友

programme.title: 我爱神仙遮
programme.desc: 推土车司机阿成，在工作时忽遇地陷而堕入一地下古庙，无意中成为油纸伞妖的主人她更将自己现身的秘密及超凡的法力告知阿成地盘工目凡叔嗜赌，欠下恶少高利贷，恶少垂涎凡叔之女美色，要凡叔以女还债；阿成得悉后请伞妖戏弄恶少，并暗助凡叔在赌场获胜，清还债项惟此神伞之秘密却被恶少发现

programme.title: 柠檬可乐
programme.desc: 就读女校高中的婷婷，因排演罗密欧与茱丽叶而与邻校男生Jackson戏假情真，爱情就在排练时萌芽这是婷婷的初恋，但Jaskson却是一个变幻莫测的爱情玩家

programme.title: 赤脚小子
programme.desc: 穷乡青年关丰曜，终日赤着双脚，以背人过河为活关父临终前，嘱其出城投靠段青云；段骤见故人之子，留下关在布店当小工关与私塾女教师华小莲交心，却遭莲父白眼；关为求出人头地，竟往投靠土霸喀和布，结果连累莲父与段相继被喀暗算身亡关得知真相，惜为时已晚，追悔莫及，决与喀拼过死活...

programme.title: 新少林寺
programme.desc: 骄横军阀侯杰在惨遭亲信曹蛮残酷背叛痛失至爱幼女后，心灰意冷下大彻大悟投身少林隐姓埋名不料野心勃勃的叛将曹蛮紧随其后引兵屠城，使千年古刹少林危在旦夕已皈依佛门的侯杰重拾昔日信念，在这场充满血色的因果轮回中，誓以血肉之躯筑起最后的救赎

programme.title: 百变星君
programme.desc: 富家子李泽星挂名留学，实际上却挥金如土，并自命情圣，称霸校园一日，因搭上黑帮老大情妇Silvia，而遭黑帮刺杀，被炸得粉身碎骨这个财大气粗的李泽星以百变金刚之姿态复活，还掌握了独特的能力，得到一份真正的工作，还有他真心爱上的意中人

programme.title: 霍家拳之精武英雄
programme.desc: 陈真奉师命赴日求学，因解救并爱上校友山田广子，就此陷入日本黑龙会的权力纷争面对华人学生接连失踪黑龙会渗透打压精武门，他联手热血青年梁少文深入敌营，捣毁秘密实验室并瓦解阴谋，与强敌展开生死决战，誓死守护民族尊严

programme.title: 让子弹飞
programme.desc: 悍匪张牧之劫持火车，冒充新任县长强横进驻鹅城本想靠升官发财大捞一笔，却撞上了只手遮天的当地地头蛇恶霸黄四郎在满嘴谎言的骗子师爷马邦德的利益周旋下，黑白两道展开一场智力与火力的巅峰对决在这场荒诞的杀戮游戏中，且看子弹如何飞往最终的真相

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 摄影师陈志成长年被一名红衣女子纠缠，导致多位亲人惨死；甚至连自己心仪的女孩思桐亦难逃恶运志成欲寻找思桐惨死的真相，却揭发关于一场冥婚的秘密...

programme.title: 无间道 II
programme.desc: 无间道的秘密最终在此前传中揭露 重案组督察黄志诚与黑帮头领韩琛的恩怨和两名卧底陈永仁与刘建明的宿命纠缠何时开始关键原来系于三个人身上：琛妻新任黑帮龙头及重案组高层无间之门亦在这最坏的时代敞开

programme.title: 煞面迷影
programme.desc: 当年轻母亲为女儿莫名失踪而苦恼时，一连串怪异的事件接踵而至这都可能与二十年前的意外亡魂为复仇归来有关

programme.title: 贼王之王
programme.desc: 两名私家侦探欲藉破一连环大劫案而声名大噪岂料调查过程中竟一再被贼王使计愚弄，笑话连篇及后更发现原来所有劫案均与日商宫本有关，到底谁才是真正的贼王之王？

programme.title: 铁线功夫拳
programme.desc: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债

programme.title: 龙的传人
programme.desc: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？

programme.title: 西游记第壹百零壹回之月光宝盒
programme.desc: 逍遥山贼斧头帮帮主至尊宝，意外得知自己是孙悟空的转世随着妖魔与仙界势力逼近，他被卷入月光宝盒引发的时空混乱之中在爱恨纠葛与不可违抗宿命之间，他必须在凡人身份与救世重任中作出抉择

programme.title: 盲战
programme.desc: 在多年前的一次反恐任务中，前特警队长东谷被悍匪炸瞎双眼，被迫退役，从此与女儿相依为命不料，昔日宿敌再度现身，绑走其女，欲将她卖入地下人口贩卖集团这位失明的法外独行侠，凭藉过人的听觉与格斗本领，只身踏上营救女儿之路

programme.title: 猩猩王
programme.desc: 探险家陈正风（李修贤）受聘赴印度森林搜捕猩猩王，结果误堕娱乐公司老板鲁天（谷峰）的圈套，将猩猩王带往香港表演同行的女泰山阿维（伊芙莲嘉）见猩猩王惨遭捉弄摆布，伤心之余更被鲁天意图强奸猩猩王睹状狂性大发，追击鲁天至市区，市民一片慌乱，军警如临大敌...全片的特技道具，一丝不苟，猩猩王爬上香港当时最高建筑物康乐大厦的镜头，令观众惊异万分导演远赴泰国森林取景，还有野性美丽的女泰山伊芙莲嘉演出，令人大饱眼福

programme.title: 我爱罗兰度
programme.desc: Lolanto自命风流，一次因伤入院结识了富商的弱智独生女儿阿蚊，她如小孩般天真可爱，渐渐更与Lolanto成为好友蚊父因此聘请Lolanto来照顾她不久，蚊入院做智力恢复手术，但恢复智力后的阿蚊与Lolanto建立的情谊却黯然离去

programme.desc: 戴顾东夏雨经营的茶餐厅受金融风暴牵连陷入财困，急需资金周转，不知内情的叶慕升许绍雄觊觎茶餐厅的铺位主动入股，顾东暂得援兵便埋头研制新菜式，谁料新请回来的散工崔喜喜商天娥炒了一碟蛋炒饭，深受米芝莲代表赏识，顾东对她宠爱有加一天，银行代表利蓉姿伍咏薇突然出现，喜喜因迷债事件与她大打出手，喜喜受伤失忆，顾东为保米芝莲星级声誉，安排所有人假装为喜喜的家人，自己是喜喜的大哥，慕升是丈夫，儿子是大提琴教师叶积良陈键锋，就连女儿戴莹莉唐诗咏也被迫由积良的女朋友变做表妹，关系乱七八糟，惹来连番笑话......麻烦事一浪接一浪，被银行辞退的蓉姿突然声称自己是茶餐厅的股东，要为茶餐厅作大改革；一家本来平凡不过的港式茶餐厅，突然三权分立，人人各怀鬼胎......

programme.title: 再生缘 第2集
programme.desc: 孟丽君叶璇父亲孟士元卢海鹏为前朝御医，饱学之士，却思想守旧，相信女子无才便是德君为求学问，女扮男装到书院读书君于四出游玩时结识了微服下江南的蒙古王孙铁穆耳马德钟及忠直少年皇甫少华林，三人结成兄弟耳看穿君女子的身份，却不道破；君对耳亦有好感元打算把君许配给世交皇甫家；与此同时，权贵刘奎璧张松枝亦向孟家提亲婚期迫在眉睫，君决定向耳表白爱意，惜耳因父病危要赶回京，将与君约会之事交托华君大为失望，并斥走华为着终身幸福，君带着侍婢离家出走君到处闯荡，因其男子之装扮而闹出不少笑话，亦牵涉入多宗惊险重重的事件中君其后分别与华及耳展开了两段若即若离的感情，更知道原来华便是与其有婚约的未婚夫，耳为皇族之后......

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第10集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第18集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第20集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 再生缘 第2集
programme.desc: 孟丽君叶璇父亲孟士元卢海鹏为前朝御医，饱学之士，却思想守旧，相信女子无才便是德君为求学问，女扮男装到书院读书君于四出游玩时结识了微服下江南的蒙古王孙铁穆耳马德钟及忠直少年皇甫少华林，三人结成兄弟耳看穿君女子的身份，却不道破；君对耳亦有好感元打算把君许配给世交皇甫家；与此同时，权贵刘奎璧张松枝亦向孟家提亲婚期迫在眉睫，君决定向耳表白爱意，惜耳因父病危要赶回京，将与君约会之事交托华君大为失望，并斥走华为着终身幸福，君带着侍婢离家出走君到处闯荡，因其男子之装扮而闹出不少笑话，亦牵涉入多宗惊险重重的事件中君其后分别与华及耳展开了两段若即若离的感情，更知道原来华便是与其有婚约的未婚夫，耳为皇族之后......

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第10集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第18集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第20集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第16集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 单恋双城 第4集
programme.desc: 任职旅行社的罗式适陈茵媺为公司开拓新业务，特赴马来西亚与客户开会，谁料被当地滑头导游陆恭梓陈展鹏破坏一切计划，二人因而结怨，式适的男朋友程展博杨明突然现身向她求婚...

programme.title: 状王之王 第15集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 单恋双城 第4集
programme.desc: 任职旅行社的罗式适陈茵媺为公司开拓新业务，特赴马来西亚与客户开会，谁料被当地滑头导游陆恭梓陈展鹏破坏一切计划，二人因而结怨，式适的男朋友程展博杨明突然现身向她求婚...

programme.title: 状王之王 第15集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 바다를 품에 안고, 세 끼를 찾아 다시 돌아온 세 남자. 가을과 겨울을 거쳐, 이번엔 여름의 어촌이다! 대가족을 꾸려 어촌으로 컴백한 잭슨과 함께해, 더욱 생기 넘치는 세끼 하우스. 싱그러운 여름을 맞이하는 무한 득량 가능한 비옥한 바다, 드넓은 갯벌, 바다내음 물씬 풍기는 목장까지! 작지만 있을 건 다 있는, 남해의 파라다이스 득량도! 그 속에서 새롭게 펼쳐지는 자급자족 바다목장 라이프. 하늘 아래 같은 음식은 없다! 잭슨 패밀리의 등장으로 더욱 다양하고 새로워진 세 남자의 삼시세끼. 비옥한 섬, 득량도에서 찾은 이들의 밥상은 과연? 고즈넉한 섬 한가운데에서 진정 느낄 수 있는 여름 제철 청량 라이프! 한낮 여름 태양보다 더 타오르는 이들의 열정으로 지어진 밥상과 특별할 것 없지만, 즐거움이 묻어나는 삼시세끼가 시작됩니다!

programme.title: 회랑정 살인사건
programme.desc: 화염에 휩싸인 그날, 진실과 마주하다. 훙예그룹 회장 가오광이의 살날이 얼마 남지 않았음을 안 가오 씨 집안사람들은 유산과 회사를 차지하기 위해 혈안이 된다. 자신의 유일한 혈육인 혼외 자식에게 유산을 물려주고 싶었던 가오광이는 장위안싱을 시켜 아들을 찾게 하고, 장위안싱은 청청을 찾아낸다. 장위안싱이 청청을 데려오기 위해 설득하는 사이 둘의 사랑은 깊어지고, 가오 씨 집안사람들은 새로운 상속자의 등장에 불편한 기색을 드러낸다. 어둠이 드리운 회랑정 호텔의 밤, 갑작스러운 화재가 발생해 장위안싱은 크게 다치고 청청은 생명의 위협을 받게 되는데...

programme.title: 회장님네 사람들
